Simple format without timestamp. In such a case, current server time will be used: 

```json
{"temperature": 26}
```

```json
{"ts":1634712287000,"values":{"temperature":26, "humidity":87}}
```

params.name: keys
params.description: A string value representing the comma-separated list of telemetry keys. If keys are not selected, the result will return all latest time series. For example, 'temperature,humidity'. If telemetry keys contain comma, duplicate 'key' parameter for each key, for example '?key=my,key&key=my,second,key

params.name: useStrictDataTypes
params.description: Enables/disables conversion of telemetry values to strings. Conversion is enabled by default. Set parameter to 'true' in order to disable the conversion.

params.name: startTs
params.description: A long value representing the start timestamp of the time range in milliseconds, UTC.

params.name: endTs
params.description: A long value representing the end timestamp of the time range in milliseconds, UTC.

params.name: intervalType
params.description: A string value representing the type fo the interval.

params.name: interval
params.description: A long value representing the aggregation interval range in milliseconds.

params.name: timeZone
params.description: A string value representing the timezone that will be used to calculate exact timestamps for 'WEEK', 'WEEK_ISO', 'MONTH' and 'QUARTER' interval types.

params.name: limit
params.description: An integer value that represents a max number of time series data points to fetch. This parameter is used only in the case if 'agg' parameter is set to 'NONE'.

params.name: agg
params.description: A string value representing the aggregation function. If the interval is not specified, 'agg' parameter will use 'NONE' value.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort order. ASC (ASCENDING) or DESC (DESCENDING)

params.description: A string value representing the comma-separated list of telemetry keys. If keys are not selected, the result will return all latest time series. For example, 'temperature,humidity'. If telemetry keys contain comma, duplicate 'key' parameter for each key, for example '?key=my,key&key=my,second,key

params.name: deleteAllDataForKeys
params.description: A boolean value to specify if should be deleted all data for selected keys or only data that are in the selected time range.

params.name: startTs
params.description: A long value representing the start timestamp of removal time range in milliseconds.

params.name: endTs
params.description: A long value representing the end timestamp of removal time range in milliseconds.

params.name: deleteLatest
params.description: If the parameter is set to true, the latest telemetry can be removed, otherwise, in case that parameter is set to false the latest value will not removed.

params.name: rewriteLatestIfDeleted
params.description: If the parameter is set to true, the latest telemetry will be rewritten in case that current latest value was removed, otherwise, in case that parameter is set to false the new latest value will not set.

items.docs: Delete time series for selected entity based on entity id, entity type and keys. Use 'deleteAllDataForKeys' to delete all time series data. Use 'startTs' and 'endTs' to specify time-range instead.  Use 'deleteLatest' to delete latest value (stored in separate table for performance) if the value's timestamp matches the time-range.  Use 'rewriteLatestIfDeleted' to rewrite latest value (stored in separate table for performance) if the value's timestamp matches the time-range and 'deleteLatest' para
